title: Retraction half of ordinary cone detection
statement: Under the native cone-detection hypotheses, the ordinary underlying map has a retraction.

source.place: Final exceptional-adjunction sentence: rotated cone splitting

proof.text: Complete and rotate the native cone; detection makes the first ordinary arrow zero, so the underlying distinguished triangle splits and yields a retraction.

lean.statement:
theorem native_ordinary_cone_retraction (R : Family l D) (T : Space D)
    (V : ForgetModel D l R T) (H M : W D l T) (q : H ⟶ M)
    (e : Nonempty (V.functor.obj H ≅ V.functor.obj M))
    (hq : ∀ (K : W D l T) (v : K ⟶ H),
      WeilComplex.forget.map (v ≫ q) = 0 → V.functor.map v = 0) :
    Nonempty (SplitMono (WeilComplex.forget.map q))
